comment: One of the best players in the world, added sources.
One source says best wingers, which leaves one source with him 18th, not a good enough backing

Raphinha is no longer playing as a winger for Barcelona, but rather as the primary striker or false 9 under Hansi Flick. However, he can indeed play as a winger or even as a CAM or an SS. So he's a very versatile forward, I'd not press on him solely being a winger as of his current run - he'll probably never go back to being a wide winger anyway.
